Start BOSCO · circular response: camera searches → confirmed fire triggers takeoff → track and circle.

Outdoor contour flight: take off to 1 m → move and scan Marker 2 → follow the +5-minute GPS contour of a 50 m-wide initial fire. Onboard wind updates the forecast; wind gaps use the last measurement or the labeled low-wind assumption. Stays airborne until LAND or a safety stop.

TINY FIRE · NO FLIGHT
Follow the forecast contour

 
A 1 m² fire starts around the second QR marker. With almost no wind (0.2 km/h), its boundary changes very little: about 5 cm of head growth over five minutes. One preview aircraft follows the +5-minute contour. No GPS or aircraft connection is used here.

 
 
Fire now+5-minute route● Initial QR area

 
 
Scrubbing changes this tiny-fire preview only. Outdoor flight uses Marker 2 to identify a separate 50 m initial fire scenario, with actual GPS and the clearly labeled measured, stale or assumed wind input.
